propositions: The verifier cannot mark operational criteria met (deploy, live E2E, console setting, drill) because evidence lives outside the codebase; operators were forced to use unsigned --force-close despite work being complete and proven live.

Criterion kind is classified deterministically from an inline author tag: [operator-attested] signals operator-attested; untagged, malformed, or absent tags default to codebase-verifiable (safe default, unchanged behavior).

Operator-attested criteria are MET only if a ticket-system attestation names ≥1 verifiable specific (reference ID, actor, measured outcome, timestamp) that substantively matches the criterion; vague assertions without specifics are NOT MET.

The injection guard is retained for all criteria and explicitly separated: a command attempts to control the verdict (rejected); an attestation reports a checkable fact (admissible evidence the verifier judges).
VerdictFinding gains optional remediation field populated for unmet operator-attested criteria, guiding authors to record proof as a comment with reference, outcome, and timestamp.

Four new eval dataset cases test concrete vs vague attestations, injection-with-factual-specifics, and unmarked fallback to codebase verification; behavioral pass/fail scored through existing deterministic scorers.
